vocabulary.meaning_en: owning something; something belongs to someone
vocabulary.example: John's hat shows possession: the hat belongs to John.

vocabulary.meaning_en: showing that something belongs to someone
made of two or more parts joined together (e.g. Bill and Hillary)
vocabulary.example: "Bill and Hillary" is a compound subject.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word that shows possession without an apostrophe: mine, his, hers, ours, theirs (and my, your...)

vocabulary.example: Alice's opinion of the house was different from mine.

vocabulary.note_ar: جمع غير قياسي: لا نقول childrens

vocabulary.example: I thought his house was too expensive.
Alice thought the house was cheap.

fine_lines.title: boy's vs boys'
fine_lines.explanation_ar: boy's = يخص ولدًا واحدًا. boys' = يخص عدة أولاد (نضع الفاصلة العليا بعد s الجمع فقط).
fine_lines.explanation_en: boy's = belonging to one boy. boys' = belonging to several boys (add only the apostrophe after the plural s).

examples.sentence: The boy's hat is red. (one boy)
The boys' hats are blue. (two boys)

fine_lines.title: Bill and Hillary's vs Barbara's and George's
fine_lines.explanation_ar: إذا كان الشيء مشتركًا بينهما نضع 's على الاسم الأخير فقط: Bill and Hillary's house. إذا كان لكلٍّ منهما شيء مختلف نضع 's على الاسمين: Barbara's and George's opinions.
fine_lines.explanation_en: If they share one thing, add 's only to the last name: Bill and Hillary's house. If each has a different thing, add 's to both: Barbara's and George's opinions.

examples.sentence: Sam and Lina's car is new. (one car)
Sam's and Lina's answers were different.

fine_lines.title: hers (not her's)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: ضمائر الملكية مثل his, hers, ours, theirs, its لا تأخذ فاصلة عليا أبدًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Possessive pronouns like his, hers, ours, theirs, its never take an apostrophe.

expressions.example: I found a pen on the floor. Is this yours?
Don't take it. This sock is mine.

grammar.title: Singular owner: add 's
grammar.explanation_ar: إذا كان المالك شخصًا واحدًا نضيف 's للاسم. هذا لا يجعله جمعًا: John's hat = قبعة جون. (مع الأسماء المنتهية بـ s يجوز James' أو James's).
grammar.explanation_en: For one owner, add 's to the noun. It does not make it plural: John's hat = the hat of John. (Names ending in s can take James' or James's.)

grammar.title: Plural owner ending in s: add ' only
grammar.explanation_ar: إذا كان الاسم جمعًا منتهيًا بـ s نضيف الفاصلة العليا فقط بعد s: the boys' hats.
grammar.explanation_en: If the plural noun already ends in s, add only an apostrophe after the s: the boys' hats.
examples: All of the rooms' colours were great.

grammar.title: Irregular plurals: add 's
grammar.explanation_ar: الجموع التي لا تنتهي بـ s (children, people, men, women) نضيف لها 's: the children's room.
grammar.explanation_en: Plurals that don't end in s (children, people, men, women) take 's: the children's room.

grammar.title: Compound owners
grammar.explanation_ar: شيء مشترك: 's على الاسم الأخير (Bill and Hillary's house). أشياء منفصلة مختلفة: 's على كل اسم (Barbara's and George's opinions).
grammar.explanation_en: Shared thing: 's on the last name (Bill and Hillary's house). Separate, different things: 's on each name (Barbara's and George's opinions).
examples: Bill and Hillary's house is nice.
Barbara's and George's opinions were different.

grammar.title: The "of" test and possessive pronouns
grammar.explanation_ar: إذا استطعت أن تقول "the ... of ..." فأنت تحتاج فاصلة عليا: the hat of John → John's hat. أما ضمائر الملكية (my, his, hers, ours, theirs, mine) فلا تأخذ فاصلة عليا.
grammar.explanation_en: If you can say "the ... of ...", you need an apostrophe: the hat of John → John's hat. Possessive pronouns (my, his, hers, ours, theirs, mine) never take one.
examples: the opinion of Alice → Alice's opinion
Her opinion was different from mine.

questions.explanation_en: Plural ending in s: add only '.

questions.explanation_ar: ضمير الملكية hers لا يأخذ فاصلة عليا.
questions.explanation_en: The possessive pronoun "hers" takes no apostrophe.

questions.explanation_ar: children جمع لا ينتهي بـ s: نضيف 's.

questions.question: "I thought all of the ___ colours were great." (many rooms)
"She thought only the ___ colour was nice." (one bedroom)
"Alice's opinion" = ___.
questions.explanation_ar: اختبار of: the opinion of Alice.
questions.explanation_en: The "of" test: the opinion of Alice.
